description: This file is a header file defining utility functions and including necessary headers for the cURL project. It declares functions for time difference calculation, string comparison, and includes licensing and project information.

methods.name: tvnow
methods.description: Returns the current time as a struct timeval.

methods.name: tvdiff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in milliseconds between two timeval structures, assuming t1 is more recent than t2.

methods.name: struplocompare
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: struplocompare4sort
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison suitable for sorting, compares two objects pointed to by void pointers.
